title: Montserrat and Cava Visit
text: There were five in our group that went to Montserrat and Torres Winery. We were picked up on time as promised by a couple who were driving a very spacious and clean Mercedes van. The guide was very informative on our trip. We went to the Cava first and then to a great lunch at a very local restaurant before going to Montserrat. The whole trip was very enjoyable and our host/guide made the excursion a real pleasure. I would certainly book again with Soberti Transfers and Tours. Our trip was in late November with great weather. Our trip was booked under the name McCabe.
author: doylej2019

title: Emmanuel was our guide to...
text: Emmanuel was our guide to Montserrat. He did a fantastic job! He accompanied us to all places and was a great guide.
author: JOSEPH A
